subcodes.title: Words spoken on 1911-Oct-27 in Paris
subcodes.first_line: The day is fine, the air is pure, the sun shines, no mist nor cloud obscures its radiance. These brilliant rays penetrate into all parts of the city
subcodes.first_line_orig: در انجیل میفرماید هر وقت حضرت مسیح میاید سوار بر ابر است جمال مبارک در تفسیر
full_text_parts: 4 Avenue de Camöens, Morning of Friday, October 27th The day is fine, the air is pure, the sun shines, no mist nor cloud obscures its radiance. These brilliant rays penetrate into all parts of the city; so may the Sun of Truth illumine the minds of men. Christ said, `They shall see the Son of Man coming in the clouds of Heaven'.
